scope: Owned records extracted from a mixed source file. JSON pointers refer to the exact source revision; this is not the complete original file.

value.intent: Create clear business-world motion with modular brand art.
reference_requirements: Approved character/brand reference or explicit placeholder status, assets and fixed state trace.
value.prompt: Direct NAVI NETWORK motion from {{APPROVED_IDENTITY_REFERENCE}}, {{ASSET_SET}} and {{STATE_TRACE}}. If the identity reference is only a C-token placeholder, retain that status rather than claiming an exact official Navi mascot. Separate hero body/accent parts, connection trail, local savings-token effects, terrain/process materials, UI and sound cues. Use friendly restrained material motion and the approved palette; introduce no military imagery or nationality-coded enemies. Obstacles represent process friction, not customers or employees. Plan state-driven idle/move/turn, supported slow/boost, hit/respawn, capture and victory with clear priorities, cancellation, looping and reduced-motion fallbacks. Keep fictional game points separate from real customer claims. Provide microtile, detailed-object and hybrid variants using the same board geometry and trace. Cosmetic replacement never alters network objectives or collider data. Deliver a component/state plan and actual playback acceptance scenarios; no storyboard or generated clip proves a game runtime implements them.
value.example_request: Animate Navi’s connections and process obstacles without making it look like a military reskin.
